definition: Fix a function from the complete readings to an arbitrary evidence type, then a Prop-valued test on that evidence. Uniform soundness requires that affirmation imply zero bias for every profile in the unrestricted constant-bias model class. SoundSelfCertificationFails says no such test can affirm on reachable derived evidence when a nonzero bias is permitted.
note: This is deductive model-class soundness, not fallible epistemic justification, psychological availability or computability. An evidence type Nat → Report includes infinitely many reading-derived reports, without adding independent input or asserting their physical production. The proof does not require completeness of the test; the exact-classifier corollary uses the existing criterion notion.
